mapper.select: SELECT id, index_id, title, content, author_id, is_deleted, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM articles WHERE index_id = #{indexId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, author_id, is_deleted, is_hidden FROM articles
title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE AND (t.is_hidden = FALSE OR t.author_id = #{viewerId} OR #{canViewHidden} = TRUE)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, is_deleted, is_hidden FROM articles WHERE author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE
AND t.is_hidden = FALSE

SELECT t.id, t.index_id, t.title, t.content, t.author_id, t.is_deleted, t.is_hidden, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, index_id, title, content, author_id, is_deleted, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM articles
title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t
AND t.is_deleted = TRUE AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.is_hidden = TRUE AND t.is_hidden = FALSE
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_id) id, is_deleted, is_hidden FROM articles
title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY index_id, updated_at DESC ) t
AND t.is_deleted = TRUE AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.is_hidden = TRUE AND t.is_hidden = FALSE
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO articles (id, index_id, title, content, author_id, created_at, updated_at, is_hidden) VALUES ( #{id},
#{indexId} DEFAULT , #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, COALESCE( (SELECT a.created_at FROM articles a WHERE a.index_id = #{indexId} LIMIT 1), #{updatedAt} ), #{updatedAt},
(SELECT a.is_hidden FROM articles a WHERE a.index_id = #{indexId} LIMIT 1)
DEFAULT
)
mapper.update: UPDATE articles SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE articles SET is_deleted = FALSE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE articles SET is_hidden = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE articles SET is_hidden = FALSE WHERE id = #{id}
